evaluator.adoption: standing model/task evaluator; 0.3.276 remains an unadopted update candidate

native_scorer.name: model_graded_qa
native_scorer.criterion_binding: Freeze the strict support/attribution rubric and independently retained numbered source passages in each native Sample.target. Bind FieldSpec.target when importing an upstream dataset; preserve original task identity.
native_scorer.rationale: Keep the upstream default instructions and grade pattern so the final offered C/I verdict is validated. Custom instructions or a custom pattern remove that offered-grade guard. The criterion is a local integration rubric, not unchanged upstream acceptance.

routing.api_key: nonsecret local gateway placeholder; native provider sign-ins remain native
routing.qualification: Native Chat header mock passed. Owner wire max covers reviewed shapes only. Responses correlation ignored: exclusive-window and per-attempt client-row binding required before freeze.

acceptance.supported_report_pass: C only, after all frozen rubric requirements hold
acceptance.parse_failure: Missing grade, malformed multi-letter grade, off-menu grade or P when partial_credit=false returns native Score.unscored(reason=grader_failed). Preserve the native record and classify the entire task-repeat block infrastructure-invalid under shared-execution-contract.json.
acceptance.coverage: Require zero UNSCORED/error records and exactly the frozen expected sample count before any quality decision. Native metrics exclude UNSCORED values; an aggregate accuracy alone cannot prove full coverage.
acceptance.test_status: Inspect 0.3.273 unchanged mock controls: pytest 0, 15 passed, one trio skip. Shared QA parser and Chat-header control covered; live grader, Responses headers, rubric and complete usage unqualified.

usage.authoritative_scope: Each distinct original provider attempt, including grader helpers, retries, failures and interruptions. A correlated aggregate substitutes only after its complete nonoverlapping coverage is established. Missing usage remains unknown.
usage.input_tokens: Inspect normalized input_tokens subtracts both cache reads and writes. Keep this native value separately labeled; it is not the original gross metric operand and normalized input plus output is not the contract metric.
usage.metric: Sum original reported gross input minus original reported cache read plus original reported output. Output includes reasoning; do not add it again. Cache writes are not an operand. Require original presence/types, finite nonnegative values and read <= gross.
usage.operand_binding: Bind original terminal provider G/R/O to the loaded gateway build, executed format/path, actual attempt/response identity and delivered grader observation. Neither normalized Inspect counters nor SDK ModelCall.response serialization authenticates pre-sanitation originals or exhaustive inner attempts. Reject unknown reconstruction.
usage.cache_presence: Native Inspect conversion collapses absent and zero details. Do not infer original presence/types from converted zeros or SDK dumps without verified preservation. Unknown writes can stay null for this metric.
usage.cost: This is a token-efficiency metric. Monetary cost and complete-cache accounting remain separately unqualified.
